notes: Always-present declaration files: every pack now ships rules.yaml, schedules.yaml, side-chats.yaml, connectors.yaml, and capabilities.yaml (empty lists where a pack needs none), and the gate treats a missing declaration file as a structural failure — legacy pre-1.7 packs that omit one still install, with the omission read as an empty declaration. Also includes the capabilities/connectors split (0.6.0), mechanical used_by id validation (0.5.1), side chat creation (0.4.0), mandatory integrity verification (0.3.1), the opt-in daily update check (0.3.0), and the Quality & Safety gate (0.2.0).
